usedFor: New QuickBooks invoices are posted to Slack for the finance or sales team.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in QuickBooks, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: One channel post shows every new invoice to the team; “Send Message” takes a channel ID.

watchOut: “New Invoice” and “New Bill” poll, so the Slack post lands after the next check and needs approval.
